# The ignored source-list file is generated by the build daemon. Keeping the
# component boundary here fixed prevents application output from changing its
# dependencies or flags while still making added and removed sources explicit.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/app_sources.cmake")
  include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/app_sources.cmake")
else()
  set(APP_SRCS "app.c")
endif()

idf_component_register(
  SRCS ${APP_SRCS}
  INCLUDE_DIRS "."
  REQUIRES
    hw_app_api esp_timer esp_hw_support esp_system freertos log
    esp_driver_gpio esp_driver_ledc esp_driver_uart esp_driver_spi
  WHOLE_ARCHIVE
)

# The camera component uses IDF 5.3's legacy I2C driver. The application does
# not require the umbrella `driver` component, because that would expose the
# mutually exclusive new I2C API and let an app link a constructor that aborts
# before the harness can report. The build daemon also rejects that API and
# inspects the final ELF.
